requirement:
> `Pass the UUID from next to read the next page in the same format. When next
> is absent, this is the last page.`
rationale:
structural: `requirements.sdk.graph.validation-context.pages.mcp.description` only fixes the text of the `get_next_page` tool description: "Pass the UUID from next to read the next page in the same format. When next is absent, this is the last page." It prescribes no library, algorithm, signature, type, field or delegation through a named interface. An implementation that built the tool definition another way, such as a constant, a macro or generated JSON, would give the same description and still satisfy the text. The text is therefore purely observable output, and no structural obligation needs implementation evidence.

The supplied root, `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/tools.rs#impl[GraphSession<'_, '_, D>/Conversation]/fn[tools]`, does emit a `get_next_page` tool definition with exactly this description. That matches the text, and no gap exists.

behavioral: The requirement has one observable obligation. The published `get_next_page` MCP tool must have the description "Pass the UUID from next to read the next page in the same format. When next is absent, this is the last page." The two-line blockquote joins into a single line with one space.

`crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/tests.rs#fn[published_tool_descriptions_match_the_contract]` covers it. It builds a `ValidationContext` with a scripted tool agent and runs `ask::<bool>()`. It then takes the tool definitions from the captured request and finds `get_next_page` by name. Finally it uses `assert_eq!` to compare `tool.description` with the exact required string. A changed, truncated or missing description would fail this assertion.

`default_tool_accepts_scalar_results_and_keeps_the_exact_prefix` in the same file also checks that `get_next_page` is published, along with its parameter schema. It doesn't check the description, but the first test already does.

No other behavior is in scope, and no acknowledgments are involved.
